jobs.title: Dynamics 365 CE Engineer
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen

Note: good command of the Dutch language in word and writing is a requirement-

UWV zet Dynamics 365 CE in voor kritische processen rondom werk en inkomen. Als Dynamics CE Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, configureren, implementeren en onderhouden van onze Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) omgeving. Je werkt nauw samen met functioneel beheerders, ontwikkelaars, testers en business stakeholders om onze CRM-oplossingen te verbeteren en uit te breiden. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het vertalen van functionele wensen naar technische oplossingen en zorgt voor een stabiele, schaalbare en gebruiksvriendelijke omgeving.

Dit ga je doen:

Ontwerpen en configureren van Dynamics 365 CE oplossingen, waaronder entiteiten, workflows, business rules, en Power Automate flows.
Customizen en uitbreiden van de Dynamics CE omgeving met behulp van JavaScript, TypeScript, en .NET (C#).
Integreren van Dynamics CE met andere systemen (bijv. Azure, SharePoint, Power Platform, en legacy systemen) via APIs, Azure Logic Apps, en Azure Service Bus.
Optimaliseren van prestaties, beveiliging en gebruikerservaring binnen de Dynamics CE omgeving.
Onderhouden en updaten van de omgeving, inclusief patch management en upgrades.
Samenwerken met DevOps-teams om CI/CD-pijplijnen te verbeteren en automatisering te bevorderen.
Adviseren over best practices en nieuwe functionaliteiten binnen het Dynamics 365 ecosysteem.
Ondersteunen bij het oplossen van complexe technische issues en incidenten.

Wat we van je verwachten

Binnen UWV wordt gewerkt op basis van ‘vertrouwen in vakmanschap’. Dit betekent dat wij op zoek zijn naar IT talent dat zich bewust is van de eigen kwaliteiten en nieuwsgierig is om zichzelf verder te ontwikkelen. Verder neem je mee:

Essentieel:

Diepgaande kennis van Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE), inclusief:
Customization (entiteiten, velden, formulieren, weergaven, dashboards)
Business Process Flows, Workflows, en Business Rules
Plugins, Custom Workflow Activities, en Web Resources (JavaScript/TypeScript)
Power Automate (Flows) en Power Apps
Datamodel en relaties, inclusief 1:N, N:1, en N:N relaties
Beveiligingsmodellen (Security Roles, Field Level Security, Hierarchy Security)
Ervaring met ontwikkelen in:
C# (.NET Framework/.NET Core) voor plugins en custom workflows
JavaScript/TypeScript voor client-side scripting en Web API integraties
RESTful APIs en OData endpoints
Kennis van Azure-diensten zoals:
Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus
Azure DevOps (repositories, pipelines, releases)
Azure Key Vault, Application Insights
Ervaring met datamigratie en ETL-processen (bijv. met KingswaySoft, Scribe, of SSIS)
Kennis van Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents)
Ervaring met ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) en CI/CD voor Dynamics 365
Kennis van SQL Server en het schrijven van complexe queries voor rapportage en data-analyse
Ervaring met integraties tussen Dynamics CE en andere systemen (bijv. SharePoint, Office 365, legacy systemen)

Pre:

Ervaring met Dynamics 365 Field Service of Customer Service modules
Kennis van Portals (Power Pages) en/of Dynamics 365 Marketing
Ervaring met Azure Synapse Analytics of Dataverse
Kennis van F# of andere functionele programmeertalen
Certificeringen zoals MB-210, MB-240, MB-400, PL-200, PL-400

Persoonlijke competenties

Analytisch sterk en probleemoplossend vermogen
Communicatief vaardig, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk
Teamplayer met een proactieve houding
Klantgericht en resultaatgedreven
Nederlands en Engels vloeiend in woord en geschrift

Wat kun je van ons verwachten

Wij vragen nogal wat, en bieden daarvoor veel terug. Je komt in een complexe agile werkomgeving terecht, waar initiatief nemen en samenwerken hoog in het vaandel staan. De functie is afwisselend en veelzijdig. We bieden je de kans aan om een directe en wezenlijk bijdrage te leveren aan de ontwikkeling van uitstekende digitale dienstverlening voor alle burgers en werkgevers van Nederland.

Werken bij UWV betekent een goede werk-privé balans en aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden. Verder kun je het volgende van ons verwachten:

Een inschaling in tot maximaal circa € 96,5K all-in totaal per jaar voor een senior kandidaat, dat is:
Inclusief een 13e maand.
Inclusief 8% vakantiegeld.
Een goede pensioenvoorziening.
Hybride werken.
Een laptop, smartphone en andere voorzieningen om thuis goed te werken.
Een werkplek die goed te bereiken is met ov.
Bij voorkeur een werkweek van 32 tot 38 uur per week.

Iets meer over ons

UWV is hét uitvoeringsinstituut voor werknemersverzekeringen en arbeidsmarktinformatie in Nederland. We zetten ons in voor werkzoekenden, werkgevers en werknemers, en spelen een cruciale rol in de digitale transformatie van de arbeidsmarkt. Onze IT-afdeling werkt continu aan innovatieve oplossingen om onze dienstverlening te verbeteren. Binnen ons Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) team zoeken we een ervaren Dynamics CE Engineer die onze klantgerichte processen verder digitaliseert en optimaliseert.

Iets voor jou?

Wij verzoeken je uitsluitend via de sollicitatielink te solliciteren.

Voor meer informatie over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met Marko Hol, Sr. Corporate Recruiter, marko.hol@uwv.nl, of via: 06-15076961.

jobs.title: Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA
jobs.description:
As a Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA, you develop software for high-tech products and machines.

In this role, you support our customers in the semiconductor, analytical instrumentation, and medical equipment industries, within the triangle of Nijmegen, Enschede, and Zwolle, by delivering smart, sustainable, and reliable software solutions. Your software expertise plays an essential role in bringing these high-tech solutions to life.

What excites you as a Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA?

As a Software Designer, you contribute to defining requirements and you are responsible for translating them into robust software designs, ensuring high-quality implementation and seamless integration. You are eager to grow into a role where you bring your own technical contribution, while guiding the development team.

From our office in Apeldoorn or at our clients’ premises, you enjoy working on:

Translating customer and system requirements into innovative, clear, and feasible concepts during the conceptual phase of projects.
Acting as a bridge between architects and engineers from a technical perspective.
Taking responsibility for a module/subsystem throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
Ensuring software quality, scalability and maintainability through sound engineering practices.
Applying strong communication skills to effectively guide and mentor a team of engineers, helping them grow and deliver high-quality results.

Sounds good? We’d love to tell you more…

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

You have a technical Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
You have 7+ years of experience in technical software development, gained in various roles and across diverse product environments and/or projects.
Over the past 4–5 years, you have worked within technical domains such as Semicon, Medical, or Analytical.
You have experience with at least two of the following programming languages: C#, C++, or Java.
You have knowledge of and/or experience with various development methodologies and techniques such as Design Patterns, UML, and Agile, and you keep your technical expertise up to date. You are looking for an environment where you can apply these developments in practice as well.
Based on your experience, you are able to coach junior engineers.
You are a team player and keep the common goal in mind.
You have a good command of both Dutch and English, spoken and written.
You hold a valid European driver’s license and are willing to travel.

This is what you can expect in return from Sioux

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to acquire an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from events together with your partner and family, summer barbecues, innovative knowledge sessions to tasty lunches and after work drinks.
You will be working at a prime location in a green, wooded environment, close to the Veluwe National Park. The perfect base within the triangle of Enschede, Zwolle, and Nijmegen.

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux-culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

Go to testimonials >

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.

Important note:

This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the US Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R.

730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require Sioux to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
What is your role?

At Lely, software is at the heart of the next generation of autonomous farming. Our robots, edge devices and cloud platforms work together to help dairy farmers operate more efficiently and sustainably.

As a Software Architect, you shape the technical direction of this ecosystem. You work closely with software engineers, product teams and other technical disciplines to design scalable solutions while helping teams continuously improve the way they build software. This is a hands-on architecture role where technical leadership, collaboration and software craftsmanship go hand in hand.

You are responsible for guiding architectural decisions across multiple domains while remaining closely connected to implementation. Whether you are defining architectural direction, supporting teams in making technical trade-offs, or contributing to critical parts of the solution yourself, your work directly influences the quality, scalability, and maintainability of our products.

Your Main Responsibilities Include

Defining and evolving end-to-end software architectures across frontend, backend, integrations, and platform domains.
Supporting development teams in making architectural decisions and balancing business needs, technical quality, and long-term maintainability.
Contributing hands-on to solution design, prototyping, and critical implementations where your expertise adds the most value.
Driving continuous improvements in areas such as scalability, modularity, technical debt reduction, and software quality.
Coaching and mentoring engineers, helping teams strengthen their technical craftsmanship and architectural thinking.
Collaborating closely with Product Management, UX, Data, and Platform teams to deliver solutions that create value for our customers.
Explore how AI-powered engineering can improve software development and help teams adopt these technologies in a practical way.

Apply now

What is your experience?

You are an experienced software professional who enjoys working at both strategic and technical levels. You know how to create alignment across teams, can communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and enjoy helping others grow.

In Addition, You Bring

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Extensive experience as a Software Architect, Lead Engineer, or Senior Software Engineer with architectural responsibilities.
A broad understanding of modern software development across multiple domains, such as frontend applications, backend services, APIs, cloud platforms, and DevOps practices.
Experience designing scalable and maintainable software architectures in complex environments.
The ability to balance innovation, technical constraints, and business priorities.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills within multidisciplinary Agile environments.
Experience with technologies such as .NET, distributed systems, cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and modern frontend frameworks is highly valuable.

What you can expect from us

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You help make the agricultural sector more futureproof, and we ensure you have the space, resources, and support to do so.

An international work environment that values collaboration, initiative, and diverse perspectives.
A culture that encourages learning, experimentation, and ownership of ideas.
Excellent employment conditions, including up to 8 weeks of vacation per year and a strong pension scheme.
A Salary range of €6600 - €9400 gross per month, with clear opportunities for growth within the scale.
Full ownership of your own development, with access to a wide range of courses through the Lely Academy.
Daily access to outstanding sports facilities at the Lely Campus: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, basketball and volleyball courts, table tennis, and table football. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
Fresh coffee and tea from our own barista (with milk from our own farm) and a healthy, affordable company restaurant.

Work-life balance

A healthy work-life balance thanks to our hybrid working policy: you work at least three days a week on Campus, with flexible hours and plenty of opportunity to spend additional time onsite (between 06:00 and 20:00).
A free shuttle bus that takes you to and from the metro station in Maassluis, ensuring your workday starts and ends smoothly.
And of course: we love to celebrate! Whether it’s an anniversary or the annual Christmas party. At Lely, we know how to do it.

We are also proud that our vision and efforts have been recognized with the Rotterdam Entrepreneurs Award 2025.

Recruitment & selection agency, consultancy, and/or staffing agency?

We appreciate the interest, but we recruit all our candidates directly. We understand that as intermediaries, you want to present candidates for our great positions and contribute to our ambitions, but this is not how we have set up our recruitment process. This means that all unsolicited profiles offered on Lely vacancies will be treated as direct applications.

About Lely

Founded in 1948, Lely is committed to a sustainable, profitable, and enjoyable future in agriculture. Driven by the challenges faced by farmers and the needs of cows, we develop high-quality robots and data systems that improve animal welfare, flexibility, and productivity on dairy farms. Our mission is to support sustainable food production.

For more than 30 years, we have been a global leader in the sale and service of automated systems for successive generations of dairy farmers. Every day, we inspire our colleagues to offer customers innovative solutions and to be a reliable partner for long-term advice and support. With our state-of-the-art Lely Campus in Maassluis and a global network of dedicated Lely Centers offering customized sales and service, Lely is active in more than fifty countries.

Ozan Arikan

jobs.title: Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT Utrecht & Haarlem - Jobbird.com
jobs.description:
Werk aan innovatieve IT-oplossingen die Nederland in beweging houden. Maak impact, groei mee en bouw aan de digitale toekomst van NS.

Jij zorgt voor de mobiliteit van Nederland
Veel ontwikkel-mogelijkheden
Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden

Daarom wil je als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT bij NS werken

Je werkt aan technologie die direct bijdraagt aan betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig treinvervoer.
Je ontwikkelt en verbetert een bedrijfskritisch MES-platform op het snijvlak van IT, OT, techniek en productie.
Je krijgt veel ruimte om slimme oplossingen te ontwerpen voor de modernisering van onze treinen in Haarlem, dicht op de operatie.

Dit ga je doen als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT

Als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT bij NS werk je aan het Manufacturing Execution System (MES) binnen NS Treinmodernisering in Haarlem. Dit bedrijfskritische platform, gebaseerd op AspenTech, ondersteunt de productie- en onderhoudsprocessen waarmee treinen worden gemoderniseerd. Daarmee heeft jouw werk direct impact op de beschikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van onze treinen.

Deze functie is anders dan een klassieke fullstack ontwikkelaarsrol. Je werkt niet alleen aan software, maar ook aan configuratie, integraties, procesontwerp en technische continuïteit binnen een operationele productieomgeving. Je schakelt met operators, productieondersteuning, functioneel beheerders, ontwikkelaars en andere collega’s om gebruikersvragen te vertalen naar robuuste technische oplossingen.

Je ontwikkelt nieuwe functionaliteiten, verbetert bestaande oplossingen en helpt verstoringen structureel op te lossen. Daarbij werk je met onder andere SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, API-koppelingen, data-integraties en MES-processen. Je denkt mee over de technische roadmap, migraties, beveiliging en de toekomst van het MES-landschap. Zo bouw je mee aan een platform dat belangrijk is voor de modernisering van treinen én voor de dagelijkse operatie in de fabriek.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

Je ontwikkelt, configureert en onderhoudt oplossingen binnen het AspenTech MES-platform.
Je vertaalt productie- en onderhoudsprocessen naar robuuste, schaalbare en praktisch toepasbare technische ontwerpen.
Je werkt aan nieuwe functionaliteiten, API-koppelingen, data-integraties en optimalisaties binnen het MES-landschap.
Je analyseert complexe vraagstukken en lost technische verstoringen structureel op, soms direct in contact met de fabriek.
Je neemt een leidende rol in technische ontwerpkeuzes en bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en veiligheid van oplossingen.
Je werkt nauw samen met functioneel beheerders, een Product Owner, Scrum Master, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers zoals operators en productieondersteuning.
Je denkt mee over technische migraties, contracten, beveiliging en toekomstige ontwikkelingen op de roadmap van het MES-platform.
Je ondersteunt bij releases, migraties en technische verbetertrajecten.
Je deelt kennis binnen het team en helpt collega’s technisch verder, zodat de afhankelijkheid van enkele kennishouders kleiner wordt.

Hier ga je werken

Je komt terecht in het MES-team binnen NS Treinmodernisering in Haarlem. Hier worden treinen vernieuwd, verbeterd en toekomstbestendig gemaakt. Binnen die omgeving speelt digitalisering een steeds grotere rol. Het MES-platform ondersteunt collega’s op de werkvloer bij productie- en onderhoudsprocessen en vormt daarmee een belangrijke schakel tussen IT, OT en de dagelijkse operatie.

Het team bestaat uit een Product Owner, Scrum Master, ontwikkelaars, een technisch applicatiebeheerder en een functioneel beheerder. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat het MES-platform stabiel blijft draaien én meegroeit met de behoefte van de fabriek. Je werkt in een omgeving waar techniek, softwareontwikkeling en productie samenkomen. Dat vraagt om nauwkeurigheid, eigenaarschap, samenwerking en de rust om ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag werk je aan een strategische verbetering van het platform, de andere dag help je een verstoring oplossen die direct impact heeft op de productie. Juist die combinatie van IT, techniek en operatie maakt deze functie interessant voor een ontwikkelaar die graag dicht bij de praktijk werkt.

Dit zijn de functie-eisen

Je bent een ervaren IT-professional of softwareontwikkelaar die technische diepgang combineert met een praktische aanpak. Je vindt het interessant om complexe systemen te doorgronden en krijgt energie van het slimmer maken van productieprocessen. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, denkt goed na over je aanpak en weet technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen.

Verder herken je jezelf in het volgende:

Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van technische informatica, software engineering, industriële automatisering of vergelijkbaar.
Je hebt ruime ervaring als software engineer, systems engineer, IT engineer of ontwikkelaar binnen complexe en bedrijfskritische IT-landschappen.
Je hebt ervaring met of aantoonbare affiniteit met MES-systemen, productieomgevingen en industriële automatisering.
Ervaring met AspenTech MES, ASM of vergelijkbare MES-platformen is een sterke pré.
Je hebt goede kennis van SQL, databases en systeemintegraties.
Je hebt ervaring met JavaScript, TypeScript en bij voorkeur enige kennis van .NET.
Je hebt ervaring met API’s, koppelingen, data-integraties en technische architecturen.
Je kunt zelfstandig verstoringen analyseren, prioriteiten bepalen en tot een structurele oplossing komen.
Je communiceert duidelijk en weet technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen, van ontwikkelaars tot gebruikers op de werkvloer.
Je bent stressbestendig, verandergericht en zelfbewust: je blijft rustig bij onverwachte situaties en durft keuzes te maken met oog voor kwaliteit en samenwerking.

Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de dynamische wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. En als één van de mooiste werkgevers van Nederland hebben we nog meer te bieden. Voor deze functie onder meer:

Een salaris tussen € 3.743,- en € 6.491,- bruto per maand op basis van schaal 60 en een 36-urige werkweek. Je inschaling is afhankelijk van je werkervaring.

Senior Backend Engineer C#/.Net (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Berlin – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

You will join one of our product teams and on a daily basis:

Design, develop, test, and ship robust, maintainable, and readable software, applications, APIs, and other workflows
Initiate, participate in, and communicate technical architecture designs
Attend regular scrum ceremonies as a member of an agile cross-functional team
Analyze, discuss, and implement business requirements while maintaining good documentation of the systems and components you create
Bring in industry standards and best practices to continually improve our codebase and architecture
Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organisational and industry standards and practices

Qualifications

What you bring:

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Experience in developing, shipping, and maintaining cloud-based applications
Good knowledge and experience working with microservices and distributed architectures
A deep understanding and knowledge of RESTful APIs
Years of experience using relational databases, preferably SQL Server. Additionally, working knowledge of ORMs, preferably Entity Framework
Familiarity with cloud development; experience with Azure is a bonus
Practical knowledge of using messaging platforms in a distributed architecture (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka)
Knowledge and experience on a FinTech and banking industry is a plus
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, and sound judgement about reviewing and testing what they produce, is a plus
Fluent English

Please note
: you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Germany.

About The Technologies We Use

Our teams have autonomy when it comes to tech choices. The example below will give you some insights, and we are looking forward to discussing this further with you.

All solutions developed cloud-native targeting Azure - Infrastructure defined using Terraform - Services deployed to Kubernetes clusters by default - A growing microservice ecosystem with event-based integration - Using latest .NET Core - RESTful API design - Single-page frontend apps served by CDN - Frontend tech using TypeScript, often Angular or standard Web Components (Stencil) - Automated tests in each layer.

Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About This Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join one of our stream-aligned engineering teams. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. You'll work in a small, full-stack team of 2-3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets.

In this role

Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production.
Deliver high quality features both individually and with other team members, working full-stack across whatever the stream requires.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to design and develop features that deliver real-world value.
Contribute to technical decision-making within your stream, including surfacing tradeoffs and risks early.
Participate in creating a psychologically safe and happy environment within the team and the company.
The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, but you commit to travelling to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What You Will Need

5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.
Experience with strongly typed languages (i.e., Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our tech stack quickly.
Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow, and curious about how AI can improve how we build.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of secure coding practices and understanding of secure development principles to building safe, trusted systems
Fluency in English is a must.

What We Offer

Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.
Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.
A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice.
Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.
Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.
We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About This Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role

Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.
Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.
Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.
Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.
Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.
Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.
Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.
The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What You Will Need

5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.
Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.
Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.
Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it.
Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.
A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.
Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.
Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.
Fluency in English is a must.

What We Offer

Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.
Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.
A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.
Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.
Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.
We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Senior Application Support Developer Mainframe (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior Application Support Developer Mainframe
beraten Kunden bei der Entwicklung, Optimierung und dem Betrieb von Softwarelösungen. Im Mainframe Umfeld unterstützen sie Kunden und Entwicklungsteams bei der Analyse technischer Herausforderungen, der Wartung und Weiterentwicklung geschäftskritischer Anwendungen sowie der Integration bestehender Host-Systeme, um stabile und effiziente Softwarelösungen bereitzustellen.

Verantwortlichkeiten

Anleiten des technischen Designs und der Architektur in Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams für Softwarelösungen und Mainframe-Anwendungen.
Leitung ausführlicher technischer Analysen und Problemlösungen zur Optimierung der Softwareleistung, Systemintegration sowie des Betriebs von Host- und Umsystemen.
Vorantreiben der Entwicklung und Implementierung von Codequalitätsstandards, Testverfahren und Überprüfungsprozessen zur Gewährleistung robuster und stabiler Softwareprodukte.
Koordinieren mit Projektmanagern und Fachbereichen, um die termingerechte Bereitstellung von Funktionen, Releasewechseln und technischen Lösungen sicherzustellen.
Unterstützung bei der Wartung und Weiterentwicklung von Mainframe-Anwendungen sowie Batchprozessen, Datenbanken und Systemumgebungen.
Anleitung und Unterstützung von Entwicklungsteams sowie Förderung von Coding Standards, Versionskontrolle und Best Practices.
Eigene Zuständigkeiten im Bereich der Verkaufsvorbereitung.
Erarbeitung von Wissen über neue Produkte, Prozesse, Methoden und Systeme.

Qualifikationen

Programmiersprachen: Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit COBOL, idealerweise ergänzt durch Kenntnisse in PL/1, Assembler oder SQL.
Zusammenarbeit & Kommunikation: Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklungsteams und Stakeholdern sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Physik, Elektro- und Informationstechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten

Mainframe-Technologien: Sicherer Umgang mit z/OS, TSO/ISPF, JCL, IBM DB2, IBM MQSeries, CICS sowie Host- und Umsystemen.
Versicherungsumfeld: Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Versicherungsprozessen und Bestandssystemen, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Bestandsführung, Vertragsmanagement, Schaden oder Tabex/4.
Batch & Job Scheduling: Erfahrung in der Steuerung, Überwachung und Planung von Batchprozessen sowie mit UC4 (Automic), JobSyncs und Job Resources.
Datenbanken & Datenmanagement: Kenntnisse in IBM DB2, SQL sowie im Umgang mit DbVisualizer und komplexen Datenbankabfragen.

Leistungen

Bei Expleo setzen wir auf Teamwork, Offenheit, Transparenz und Wertschätzung. Wir gehen unsere Aufgaben gemeinsam an
Bei uns erwartet dich ein internationales und multikulturelles Team
Bei uns sind alle gleich und wir tragen alle die gleiche Farbe: LILA!
Wir bieten dir Gleitzeit, ein ausführliches Onboarding, Home-Office-Möglichkeiten und unzählige Mitarbeiter-Benefits. Wir bieten einen Arbeitsplatz, der deine persönlichen Lebensumstände berücksichtigt und dich absichert
Man lernt nie aus: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns sehr am Herzen. Wir bieten interne Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und unterstützen dich und deine perspektivischen Ziele
Wir haben Lust etwas zu bewegen, uns gegenseitig zu motivieren und freuen uns, wenn auch du deinen Teil zum großen Ganzen beitragen: Deine Erfahrung, deine Ideen und dein Engagement finden bei uns Gehör und werden honoriert
Unsere Kunden können sich nicht nur sehen lassen; sie gehören zu den Top-Playern ihrer Branchen, in den Bereichen Banken und Versicherungen, Automotive, Luftfahrt, Transport, Life Science und viele mehr
Das soziale Miteinander ist uns wichtig. Wir setzen auf Teambuilding und Identifikation

Du willst mehr über uns wissen? Besuche einfach unseren Youtube-Kanal und schau Dir unsere Videos an. Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung und darauf, Dich persönlich kennenzulernen.

Concept Reply ist innerhalb der Reply Gruppe auf die Entwicklung von KI- und IoT-Technologien (AIoT) spezialisiert. Aufgaben

Du besprichst Requirements direkt mit dem Kunden, entwirfst darauf basierend technische Lösungen und arbeitest bei deren Implementierung mit

Qualifikation

Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Mathematik, Naturwissenschaften oder Ingenieurwissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Softwareentwicklung

Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung in Java, JavaScript / Node.js, , SQL / noSQL Datenbanken und Cloud Computing (Azure, AWS)

Grundlegende Erfahrung in Web-Technologien wie JavaEE, Spring, Python, Websocket und Event-Driven Architectures (MQTT, AMQP, Apache Kafka) sowie erste Erfahrung in Bereichen wie Machine Learning oder generative AI (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LLMs)

Kenntnisse in Continuous Integration and Deployment, sowie Projektmanagement und Kommunikation (Scrum, Kanban, Atlassian Jira, Confluence, Git, Slack)

Du bringst fließende mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Deutsch mit und bist zu einer gelegentlichen Reisetätigkeit bereit

Benefits

Modernes, hybrides (remote und im Büro) Arbeiten in High-End Offices

Individuelle und systematische (externe und interne) Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

Modernes Arbeiten in einem innovativen und internationalen Team

Flache Hierarchien sowie eine ausgeprägte Vertrauens- und Feedback-Kultur

Regelmäßige Events wie Meetups, Summits und gesellschaftliche Veranstaltungen

Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote über EGYM Wellpass

Mentoring und Coaching sowie eine gute Work-Life Balance

mit PowerShell
und Desired State Configuration (DSC)
.

Lösungen. Sie agieren als technische:r Expert:in, Berater:in und Trusted Advisor und entwickeln skalierbare, produktionsreife Automatisierungslösungen für hybride und Cloud-Umgebungen.

Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation / Berufserfahrung

Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)

Sehr gute Kenntnisse in PowerShell (Engineering-Level, nicht nur Skripting)
Erfahrung mit Desired State Configuration (DSC) und idempotenten Konfigurationen
Sicherer Umgang mit Git, GitHub und/oder Azure DevOps

Gute Kenntnisse in Windows Server, Active Directory und grundlegenden Infrastrukturthemen

jobs.title: Software Architect .NET Banking (all genders)
jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Softwarearchitektur: Du entwirfst zukunftssichere Softwarearchitekturen im .NET-Umfeld für Banken und Finanzdienstleister und verantwortest ihre Umsetzung in komplexen Projekten.
Banking-Modernisierung: Du verbindest klassische Enterprise-Architekturen wie Monolithen, Client-Server-Systeme und On-Premises-Landschaften mit modernen Ansätzen wie Microservices, Containern und eventgetriebenen Architekturen.
Standards & Governance: Du definierst und etablierst Architektur- und Technologiestandards wie Cloud-native, API-First, Security by Design und Domain-Driven Design und berücksichtigst dabei die besonderen Anforderungen des Banking-Umfelds.
Stakeholder-Management: Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen aus Banken und Finanzdienstleistungsunternehmen in tragfähige technische Lösungen und arbeitest eng mit Kundenseite, Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams zusammen.
Innovation & Qualität: Du bewertest Trends wie AI-Integration, Serverless, Observability, Zero-Trust-Security und DevSecOps im Hinblick auf sichere, resiliente und zukunftsfähige Banking-Anwendungen.

DEIN PROFIL

Qualifikation & Erfahrung: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Design und in der Dokumentation komplexer Softwarearchitekturen mit. Idealerweise hast du bereits in Projekten für Banken oder Finanzdienstleister gearbeitet.
.NET & Cloud Engineering: Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in C# und .NET Core sowie in Cloud-Services wie Azure, AWS oder GCP, Container-Orchestrierung mit Kubernetes und Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform oder Bicep.
Modernisierung & Plattformen: Du hast bestehende Systeme zu Microservices sowie Cloud- und SaaS-Lösungen modernisiert und Legacy-Systeme zu skalierbaren Plattformen transformiert.
Banking & Security: Du bringst ein Verständnis für die Anforderungen geschäftskritischer Anwendungen im Banking mit und verfügst über Know-how in Anforderungsanalyse, Betriebskonzepten und Security-Architekturen.
Moderation & Coaching: Du moderierst Architektur-Workshops sicher, agierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Business und Tech und coachst Entwicklungsteams.
KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adesso dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.

das volle Potential der Cloud ausschöpfen? .

, Düsseldorf
, Frankfurt (Main)
, Hamburg
, Hannover
, Köln
, München
und Stuttgart
.

Cloud Solution Design & Architecture: Entwickle cloud-native Lösungen und übersetze Anforderungen unserer Mandanten in skalierbare und sichere Architekturen.
Automation & Deployment: Implementiere CI/CD-Pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code und Monitoring-Frameworks für stabile Abläufe.
Engineering Excellence: Fördere Best Practices durch Code-Reviews, Testautomatisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner, verteilter Softwarearchitekturen mit Fokus auf Containerisierung, Kubernetes, Microservices und Infrastructure-as-Code
Sicherer Umgang mit Programmiersprachen wie Python, Java oder C# sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke in agilen Teams und Interesse an KI-/ML-Technologien
Reisebereitschaft sowie Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)
Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, KI-Potenziale zu identifizieren, kritisch zu bewerten und gezielt für innovative Lösungsansätze, fundierte Empfehlungen und messbaren Kundennutzen einzusetzen

Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr

jobs.title: Software Architect SharePoint (all genders)
jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Teamarbeit: In interdisziplinären Projektteams und technisch anspruchsvollen Softwareprojekten bist du für die Definition und Realisierung von modernen Anwendungsarchitekturen zuständig.
Anwendungsentwicklung: Du schaffst webbasierte Anwendungen im geschäftskritischen Umfeld unserer Kunden.
Architekturkonzeption: Du konzipierst, designst und entwickelst in Softwareprojekten.
Problem- und Spezifikationsanalyse: Du analysierst Problemstellungen und erstellst technische Spezifikationen.
Kundeninteraktion: Du arbeitest mit Kundenvertretern/-innen aus allen Funktionsbereichen (IT/Fachbereich) zusammen.
Technologieeinsatz: Je nach Projektkontext nutzt du zukunftsweisende Java/JavaScript-basierte Client/Server-Architekturen, Microservices, Webanwendungen und Cloud-Technologien.

DEIN PROFIL

Akademischer Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Architekturerfahrung: Erfahrung in der Definition von Software-Architekturen im SharePoint-Umfeld sowie in der Spezifikation und Konzeption von Anforderungssystemen, von der Erstellung von Betriebskonzepten bis zur Inbetriebnahme von Lösungen.
Kompetenzen: Sehr gute Kenntnisse gängiger moderner Komponentenmodelle und Entwurfsprinzipien sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Entwicklungsteam.
Verantwortungsbereitschaft: Bereitschaft zur Übernahme von Verantwortung für mittlere bis große Projektteams.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso.
Sprachkenntnisse: Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

jobs.title: Senior IT-Consultant Software-Testautomatisierung (all genders)
jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Gestalte Testarchitekturen: Entwickle und pflege Testautomatisierungsarchitekturen und stelle die Qualität geschäftskritischer Software sicher.
Implementiere und überwache Tests: Setze Automatisierungslösungen um, integriere sie in CI/CD-Pipelines, generiere Testdaten und führe automatisierte Testfälle aus, dokumentiere Abweichungen und stimme deren Behebung mit dem Entwicklungsteam ab.
Koordiniere Teams und Lasttests: Leite kleine Teams von technischen Testern, implementiere Testszenarien für Lasttests und stelle sicher, dass sie effizient ausgeführt werden.
Berate Stakeholder: Unterstütze User der Fachabteilungen und Entwicklungsteams bei Fragen zur Softwarequalität und Testmaßnahmen.
Unterstütze die Testplanung: Trage durch Schätzungen und Statusberichte zur Planung und Steuerung von Testaufgaben bei.
Arbeite neue Teammitglieder ein: Unterstütze neue Tester:innen bei der Einarbeitung und teile dein Wissen, um den Testprozess kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

DEIN PROFIL

Fachliche Qualifikation: Ein Ausbildungs- oder Studienabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik bildet deine Basis für diese Rolle.
Testautomatisierung und Programmiersprachen: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in agilen Projekten mit DevOps mit und bist sicher in mindestens zwei Programmiersprachen wie Java, TypeScript, C# oder Python.
Know-how in Automatisierung: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von Automatisierungslösungen mit Technologien wie Playwright oder Selenium und kannst diese in CI/CD-Pipelines wie Jenkins oder GitLab integrieren.
Testdaten und Umgebungen: Synthetische Generierung von Testdaten und Containerisierung von Testumgebungen, z.B. mit Docker und Kubernetes sind dir nicht fremd.
Schnittstellen: Vertrautheit mit dem automatisierten Test für synchrone Schnittstellen (Client-Server) und asynchrone Schnittstellen (Microservices) wie REST, SOAP, AMQP oder MQTT gehören zu deinem Skillset.
KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description:
We’re On the Beach! Since 2003, we've been rewriting the rules of how people discover, book, and experience their perfect getaway. What started as connecting people to short-haul beach holidays has evolved into something much bigger - premium beach destinations, long-haul adventures, and vibrant city breaks – and that’s just the beginning of our story.

We send around two million holidaymakers on their dream breaks every year. And we're still growing.

Powered by our deep-rooted entrepreneurial spirit, proprietary tech, curiosity and our incredible people, we’re accelerating - delivering best in class technology, the ultimate holiday app, and experiences that keep our customers coming back for more.

Ready to build the future of travel with us?

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend), you’ll design and build scalable applications, services and platforms across On the Beach.

This is a full-stack engineering position with a stronger emphasis on backend engineering, distributed systems and cloud-native architecture.

Our backend engineers solve a wide variety of problems. You could be working on systems responsible for communicating with external travel suppliers, processing large volumes of hotel inventory and pricing information, powering customer search experiences, or ensuring bookings move reliably through complex transactional workflows.

You’ll work across the development lifecycle and collaborate with engineers, product managers and other technical specialists to design, build, deploy and operate reliable software at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing Day To Day

Designing and building scalable backend applications and services
Developing APIs used by customer-facing applications and internal systems
Integrating with external suppliers and third-party platforms
Building systems that process high volumes of requests and data
Designing distributed and event-driven architectures
Working with asynchronous messaging and streaming technologies
Solving problems around performance, latency, resilience and availability
Improving caching and data-access strategies
Building reliable transactional workflows
Developing applications and services within AWS
Deploying and operating containerised applications
Improving monitoring, alerting and observability
Exploring AI-assisted engineering and modern development tooling

At Senior level, you’ll be expected to understand the wider system rather than only the individual service you are working on.

You should be comfortable considering how systems behave in production, identifying failure scenarios and balancing scalability, resilience, maintainability and delivery speed.

We’re looking for strong full-stack engineers whose experience leans towards backend and platform engineering.

You’ll be a great addition to our team if you have the following skills, knowledge and experience

Strong commercial backend software engineering
C# and .NET or comparable experience building modern backend applications
Designing and developing APIs
Building distributed systems and service-oriented architectures
Developing cloud-native applications, ideally within AWS
Working with messaging, asynchronous processing or event-driven architecture
Designing reliable integrations with external or internal systems
SQL and/or NoSQL data stores
Building scalable systems handling significant traffic or data volumes
Performance optimisation, caching and latency reduction
Designing for resilience and failure
Containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
Observability, monitoring and operating production systems
Automated testing and modern engineering practices

We don’t expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and evidence of solving comparable problems at scale are more important than matching every individual tool.

What We’re Looking For At Senior Level

Beyond the technologies themselves, we’re looking for someone who:

Can independently solve complex engineering problems
Thinks about the customer and commercial impact of technical decisions
Understands the trade-offs between speed, quality and long-term maintainability
Can contribute meaningfully to technical and architectural discussions
Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues
Raises engineering standards through collaboration rather than hierarchy
Helps less experienced engineers develop
Is comfortable working in an environment where priorities and problems can change quickly

What To Expect From Our Interview Process

After a call with our Talent Acquisition Team, We will run a 3 stage interview process all on Microsoft Teams, Which will consist of:

Hiring Manager meet & greet - 30 Minutes

Behavioural & ways of working - 60 Minutes

Tech Pairing & System Design - 120 Minutes, broken down into two parts (50 minutes each) with a short break and time for your questions at the end.

We want to make sure everybody has the opportunity to perform at their best. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the interview process please let the Talent Acquisition team know and they will be happy to assist.

Ways of working

Our full time hours are 37.5 per week, but we don't have rigid working hours so you can find the working pattern that's right for you. We have core working hours between 10am - 4pm, so we can collaborate and enjoy the social side of work.

We also have hybrid working so we all work from home and from our Aeroworks office in Manchester City Centre. We operate a remote-first working model, with colleagues meeting in our Manchester office one day every two weeks. Please note that all applicants must be eligible to work full-time in the UK

Our Benefits

We might be biased but we think our colleagues are pretty great. They're the people that have made On the Beach what it is today and continue to make it vibrant and successful tomorrow. That's why we offer a competitive benefits package, known as our Beach Perks, to all On the Beach colleagues.

These Include

25 days holiday plus your birthday off
Generous discount on holidays, plus you will receive 2 extra days annual leave on top of your holiday allowance to use whilst you're away on your On the Beach package holiday
Access to Learnerbly learning platform, plus workshops, courses and professional qualifications
Enhanced maternity, paternity, shared parental leave and adoption pay, plus other family friendly support
Employee Assistance Programme and free access to counselling
Simplyhealth Optimise Health Plan
Company Sick Pay scheme
Regular wellbeing events
Gym discount
Share Incentive Plan (SIP)
Death in Service cover
Onsite subsidised coffee shop
The Sandbox (our very own bar)
Food and drink discounts across a number of venues in Manchester City Centre
Regular social events
Cycle to Work scheme

We're On the Beach! One of the UK's largest online package holiday specialists, with significant opportunities for growth.

jobs.title: MS SQL Developer / C# – Full Stack
jobs.description:
Company Description
CMDportal (Capital Market Data Institute) is a global platform dedicated to improving transparency in bond and money markets. The organization provides access to high-quality fixed income data, analytical tools, and a network of market professionals to support better decision-making. By connecting institutions, experts, and technology, CMDportal helps market participants navigate market complexity, enhance visibility, and uncover new opportunities. Together with its members, CMDportal is building a global capital markets network aimed at making fixed income markets more accessible, transparent, and efficient. More information is available at https://www.cmdportal.com.
Role Description
This is a full-time, on-site MS SQL Developer / C# – Full Stack role based in London. The role involves designing, developing, and maintaining database solutions using MS SQL Server to support CMDportal’s data-driven applications and services. The developer will build and enhance full stack features using C# and related frameworks, integrating data sources and business logic into user-facing functionality. Day-to-day responsibilities include writing performant SQL queries and stored procedures, implementing APIs, optimizing existing code, and ensuring data integrity and security across systems. The role also includes collaborating with product and data teams, troubleshooting production issues, and contributing to continuous improvement of development practices and system architecture.
Qualifications

Strong MS SQL Server skills, including database design, query optimization, and stored procedure development.
Proficiency in C# and .NET for full stack development, including backend services and integration with data layers.
Experience with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or modern frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or similar).
Knowledge of RESTful APIs, integration with external data sources, and secure data handling practices.
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows.
Understanding of capital markets or fixed income products is highly beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to work on-site in London, collaborate in a multidisciplinary team, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

We're hiring Senior Engineers into our team, based in the North of England. You'll be a hands-on individual contributor, enabling our client facing teams, building real solutions that create measurable value, concentrating your engineering effort on solving in our GenAI platform, or building around and outside it when needed.

A look into the role

The work spans the full stack of what engineering needs to do around a GenAI platform: solving problems natively, backend plumbing, API integrations, MCP server builds, and data connections.

Working in our GenAI platform doesn't always mean writing code. Often it means applying engineering judgement to solve problems natively, designing the right architecture, the right integration, the right data flow, directly within the platform itself. Knowing which mode the problem calls for is part of the craft here.

At Senior Engineer level, you'll own your delivery end-to-end. You translate business need into solutions and technical design, and work individually or as part of the team to solve those in the best way at pace.

You're fluent across AI-native engineering from building natively in the platform, using AI tooling to accelerate your own craft, and taking coalface experiments through to production-grade operationalised solutions.

At Senior Engineer level, that fluency is already there and you apply it independently.

Knowing you’re right for us

At Senior Engineer level you have a track record of owning delivery end-to-end in a team-based model. You've shipped production software and can speak to the decisions you made. Building an inclusive culture, where we value difference and respect our colleagues helps our people to perform at the best of their ability and realise their potential.

Our open and accessible culture means you’ll interact with leaders who are interested in you and everything you bring to our firm. The things that set you apart, we value them. That’s why we give you the freedom to bring your whole self to work and pursue your passions inside and outside of work.

Beyond the job

Life is more than work. The things you do, and the people you’re with outside of work matter, that’s why we’re happy to look at flexible working options for all our roles, and we’ll always do our best to keep your work and life in balance.

The impact you can make here will go far beyond your day job. From secondments, to fundraising for local charities, or investing in entrepreneurs in the developing world, you’ll be giving back to society . It’s that drive to do the right thing that runs through our every move, grounded in our firm’s values – purposefully driven, actively curious and candid but kind.

We’re looking for people who want to contribute, spark fresh ideas and go beyond expectations. People who want to be able to proudly do what’s right, for the firm, our clients, our people and themselves. It’s how it should be.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm or Tallinn – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

You will join one of our product teams and on a daily basis:

Design, develop, test, and ship robust, maintainable, and readable software, applications, APIs, and other workflows
Initiate, participate in, and communicate technical architecture designs
Attend regular scrum ceremonies as a member of an agile cross-functional team
Analyze, discuss, and implement business requirements while maintaining good documentation of the systems and components you create
Bring in industry standards and best practices to continually improve our codebase and architecture
Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organisational and industry standards and practices

Qualifications

What you bring:

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Experience in developing, shipping, and maintaining cloud-based applications
Good knowledge and experience working with microservices and distributed architectures
A deep understanding and knowledge of RESTful APIs
Years of experience using relational databases, preferably SQL Server. Additionally, working knowledge of ORMs, preferably Entity Framework
Familiarity with cloud development; experience with Azure is a bonus
Practical knowledge of using messaging platforms in a distributed architecture (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka)
Knowledge and experience on a FinTech and banking industry is a plus
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, and sound judgement about reviewing and testing what they produce, is a plus
Fluent English

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Germany.

All solutions developed cloud-native targeting Azure - Infrastructure defined using Terraform - Services deployed to Kubernetes clusters by default - A growing microservice ecosystem with event-based integration - Using latest .NET Core - RESTful API design - Single-page frontend apps served by CDN - Frontend tech using TypeScript, often Angular or standard Web Components (Stencil) - Automated tests in each layer.

Create a safer world with us!

Your work at MSAB will bridge the gap between technology and justice. You will be inspired to go beyond your comfort zone, and you will deal with challenging and meaningful projects. jobs.title: DevOps Architect
jobs.description:
Er du klar for å bygge Azure -plattformer som faktisk havner i produksjon, ikke bare i PowerPoint?  
Vil du bli del av et fagmiljø som deler kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess – og som liker folk som både kan kode, forklare og utfordre?  
Vil du jobbe i Oslo hos en global Microsoft-partner, med lokale kollegaer, store kunder og prosjekter som sjelden er små?  

Vi har skrevet stillingen som kode. Nå mangler vi bare deg som kjører apply .

resource " devops_arkitekt " "softwareone" {  
  location = "Oslo" # men magien skjer hos kunden  
  language = [  
    " norsk ", # ( flytende )  
    " engelsk "  
  ]  
  security_clearance = " må-kunne-oppnås "  
  stack              = [  
    "Azure",  
    "Terraform",  
    "Bicep",  
    "Kubernetes/ containere "  
  ]  
  cost_conscious      = true  
}  

Terraform vil utføre følgende handlinger:  

# devops_arkitekt.softwareone vil bli opprettet  
+ ansettelse  

Plan: 1 å legge til, 0 å endre, 0 å ødelegge.  

Vil du utføre disse handlingene?  
Skriv 'ja' for å bekrefte. ▊  
Hvorfor akkurat denne rollen ?

De fleste arkitektroller ender opp i PowerPoint. Denne ender i produksjon.  
Som DevOps Arkitekt hos oss sitter du ikke og tegner mållandskap for et selskap du aldri møter. Du sitter hos kunden, der kompleksiteten faktisk bor, der legacy -systemet ingen tør å røre står ved siden av landingssonen dere skal bygge. Du får eierskapet fra første workshop til siste pipeline-kjøring.  
Og du gjør det uten å brenne kundens budsjett. Vi mener at god arkitektur er billigere enn dårlig arkitektur, og vi ser etter deg som klarer å forsvare en teknisk beslutning både overfor en utvikler og en økonomidirektør, i samme møte.  
L urer du på hvorfor selskaps navnet ikke klinger helt: mye av miljøet du kommer inn i, er det du kjenner som Crayon. Vi er nå SoftwareOne – samme fagfolk, samme kunder, større ryggdekning.  
Og internt er det høyt under taket. Stor tillit, kort vei til beslutninger, og et team som deler kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess. Du får rom til å utvikle deg i den retningen du selv vil.  
Dette blir hverdagen din

Designe og bygge infrastruktur i Azure ,  landingssoner, nettverk, sikkerhet og styring – etter beste praksis, ikke etter vane  

Skrive infrastruktur som kode i Terraform og/eller Bicep , slik at det som funker i dag også funker om to år og tre konsulenter  

Kjøre containerbaserte plattformer på Kubernetes , eller ta steget dit sammen med kunden  

Være kundens tekniske og strategiske motpart – den som sier «det der bør vi ikke gjøre», og som blir hørt  

Holde workshops og dele kunnskap med både teknikere og folk som ikke vet hva en YAML-fil er, og ikke burde måtte vite det  

Bruke KI aktivt i eget arbeid, og være nysgjerrig på hvordan det endrer måten vi leverer på

Vi tror du kjenner deg igjen i minst tre av disse

Du har konsulent- og prosjekterfaring, og trives best når du er ute hos kunden.  

Du kan Azure godt, og har erfaring med IaC – Terraform, Bicep eller begge.  

Du har jobbet med Kubernetes , eller i det minste containere, og vet hvorfor det ikke alltid er svaret.  

Du tenker kostnad og verdi før du tenker teknologi.  

Du har en gang skrevet « temporary fix » i en kommentar som fortsatt står i produksjon. Vi dømmer ikke. Vi har alle vært der.  

Erfaring fra AWS, GCP eller OVH Cloud er en fin bonus, vi jobber teknologiuavhengig.  

Job Requirements
H va du får igje n?

Et fagmiljø som faktisk deler – kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess. Sertifiseringer og kurs. Tett oppfølging fra din leder, med retning i egen utvikling.  
Naprapat på huset, og forsikrings- og pensjonsordning  

Rabatter på blant annet SATS, Ruter og Visma-biblioteket  

Dekket mobil og internett  

Rekrutteringsbonus når du henter inn en god kollega  

Nye lokaler med kantine, innendørs sykkelparkering og verksted, garderober, shuffleboard og eget hvilerom

About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About The Role

We're looking for a Deployed Architect to join our Professional Services team. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, deploy, and optimize production-grade AI infrastructure and agent systems. You'll be responsible for architecting scalable, secure infrastructure deployments and building reliable, well-evaluated agent applications that solve real business problems.

This role combines software development, infrastructure/platform engineering, and customer-facing skills. You'll work on everything from Kubernetes cluster design to multi-agent system architecture, requiring deep technical expertise across both infrastructure and agent engineering domains.

This role offers direct impact on customer success, the opportunity to shape best practices, and work with cutting-edge AI technology. You'll join a collaborative team environment with a strong engineering culture.

Key Responsibilities
