jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Solution Architect to join our ever-evolving Payouts team and help shape the future of global commerce.

What You’ll Own

You will define target architectures, set engineering standards, and work closely with product, platform, and delivery teams to translate business goals into robust technical solutions. Ideal candidates combine strong systems thinking with hands-on knowledge of cloud-native patterns, eventing, APIs, and DevSecOps.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture and Design
Define target and transitional architectures for microservices-based systems, including domain boundaries, service contracts, and data ownership.
Create and maintain architecture artifacts: context diagrams, sequence diagrams, service interaction models, API specifications, and deployment topologies.
Select and standardize architectural patterns (e.g., event-driven architecture, choreography vs. orchestration, CQRS, saga patterns, API gateway/BFF).
Ensure designs address non-functional requirements: scalability, reliability, performance, security, observability, and cost efficiency.

Technical Leadership
Provide hands-on guidance to engineering teams on service decomposition, API design, data modeling, and cloud-native implementation.
Establish and champion coding and design standards, reference implementations, and reusable templates.
Conduct architecture reviews, threat modeling, and design walkthroughs; manage technical risk and drive remediation plans.

Governance and Quality
Define guardrails for microservices (e.g., versioning, backward compatibility, resilience patterns, health checks, retries/circuit breakers, idempotency).
Partner with platform/DevOps teams to ensure CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and runtime policies align with architectural standards.
Drive observability-by-design: metrics, logs, traces, SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and incident postmortems.

Stakeholder Collaboration
Work with product managers to align technical roadmaps with business outcomes and OKRs.
Communicate complex architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders; facilitate trade-off discussions.
Collaborate with Security, Compliance, and Data teams to meet regulatory and data governance requirements.

Roadmapping and Innovation
Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and managed services; perform proofs of concept and ROI assessments.
Contribute to the evolution of domain-driven design across the organization; mentor engineers and junior architects.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years in software engineering/architecture with 4+ years designing and delivering microservices at scale.
Strong proficiency in:
Domain-Driven Design (DDD), bounded contexts, and service granularity.
API design (RESTful, gRPC) and event-driven patterns (Kafka, Pulsar, SNS/SQS, or similar).
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and core services (e.g., ECS/EKS/AKS/GKE, API Gateway, Lambda/Functions, IAM).
Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and ingress.
Data architectures for microservices: polyglot persistence, transactional boundaries, eventual consistency, and streaming.
Reliability and scalability patterns: circuit breakers, bulkheads, timeouts, backoff/retry, rate limiting, caching.
Observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, Jaeger/Zipkin.
CI/CD and DevSecOps: GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), security scanning, secrets management.

Solid experience with at least one modern language and framework (e.g., Java/Spring Boot, .NET, Node.js, Go, or Python/FastAPI).
Demonstrated track record leading complex programs from architecture through production, including migration from monoliths to microservices.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

It’s a bonus if you have

Experience in regulated or high-availability domains (e.g., payments, fintech, healthcare, e-commerce).
Familiarity with zero-downtime deployments, blue/green and canary strategies, feature flags, and progressive delivery.
Knowledge of API management platforms and developer portals.
Security expertise: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, secrets rotation, tokenization, and threat modeling.
Performance engineering: capacity planning, load testing, and cost optimization.
Event streaming design at scale: exactly-once semantics, schema evolution (e.g., Avro/Protobuf with schema registry).
Experience with multi-region, active-active architectures and disaster recovery.

About The Team

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

¡Hola! Somos OGA

Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo.

Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico.

Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico.

Sobre la posición.

Buscamos un/a Senior Full Stack Developer con experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web, tanto en el lado del servidor como en el lado del cliente, para unirse a nuestro equipo.

¿Qué harás?

Desarrollarás Software, tanto en Backend como en Frontend.

Diseñarás, desarrollarás y mantendrás aplicaciones web completas, trabajando tanto en el frontend (Angular) como en el backend (.NET), asegurando un código limpio, mantenible y de alta calidad.

Propondrás y definirás arquitecturas de software escalables, eficientes y seguras, alineadas con las necesidades del negocio y las mejores prácticas del sector.

Crearás y consumirás APIs RESTful o GraphQL para garantizar una comunicación fluida entre las capas del frontend y backend, así como con servicios externos.

Diseñarás y administrarás bases de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.) y NoSQL (MongoDB, etc.), asegurando un acceso eficiente, seguro y adaptado al volumen de datos esperado.

Configurarás y mantendrás pipelines de integración y entrega continua, automatizando pruebas, builds y despliegues en entornos cloud o on-premise.

Actuarás como referente técnico, proporcionando retroalimentación constructiva en revisiones de código, guiando a desarrolladores junior y promoviendo la adopción de estándares de desarrollo y buenas prácticas.

Analizarás y mejorarás la velocidad, eficiencia y capacidad de respuesta de las aplicaciones, asegurando una experiencia de usuario óptima.

Trabajarás estrechamente con equipos de producto, diseño, infraestructura y otros departamentos, participando activamente en ceremonias ágiles (sprint planning, dailies, retros, etc.) para garantizar el éxito del proyecto.

Investigarás, evaluarás e implementarás tecnologías emergentes que puedan aportar valor al equipo o a los proyectos.

Timing de primeras semanas en OGA

Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación.

Titulación de Grado en Ingeniería del Software, alternativamente, Grado Superior en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Web o Aplicaciones Multiplataforma.

Conocimientos en API REST, Docker, Plataforma Cloud: Azure, AWS o GCP y Pruebas unitarias.

Experiencia mínima profesional de 5 años en Desarrollo con framework Microsoft .NET 6, ASP.NET Core 3.1 o superior, en Angular v14, en Desarrollo JavaScript ES6+, HTML 5 y CSS 3, en Patrones de diseño: DDD, Clean Architecture, CQRS y en Lenguaje SQL y diseño de base de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL).

Conocimientos en UI/UX.

Uso de herramientas de testing: Postman o Selenium.

Conocimientos de CI & CD.

Conocimientos de Kubernetes.

Conocimientos de Arquitectura de microservicios.

Conocimientos de Python.

Trabajo en equipo en marcos de trabajo Agile y uso de herramientas de gestión

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla.

Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras.

Colaboración permanente con el Grupo CÁTEDRA, el Consejo Asesor Tecnológico de OGA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos.

Acceso a diversas herramientas de IA Generativa, que nos ayudan a acelerar tiempos de entrega, aumentar capacidad productiva, minimizar desgastes y sobrecargas, y en definitiva maximizar la eficiencia y rentabilidad de OGA.

Sesión de onboarding con responsables de OGA y de People, en la que te entregaremos tu kit de bienvenida.

Participación en eventos corporativos donde podrás conocer e interactuar con el resto del equipo de una forma distendida y divertida.

Asistencia al congreso anual del Grupo CÁTEDRA en Sevilla, donde se presentan los últimos avances y proyectos en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, con una completa agenda científica, formativa y de debate.

Plan de formación continua. En OGA, la formación continua es un valor clave y un pilar de nuestro compromiso con el desarrollo personal y profesional. Nos inspiramos en el concepto de ikigai, buscando que cada persona encuentre aquello que le motive y le permita crecer dentro de la organización. Por eso, te propondremos acciones formativas que consideremos valiosas para tu crecimiento. Sin embargo, serás tú quien debe tomar la iniciativa en tu propio desarrollo, identificando aquello que te apasiona y proponiendo a tu responsable las formaciones que desees realizar. jobs.description:
130 years of trust, time to shape what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers - built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer (m/f/d)
to join the Data and AI Transformation Engineering team, responsible for designing and building scalable backend platforms that expose AI and automation capabilities as reliable, production grade services.

The role focuses on developing API driven systems deployed on Kubernetes, combining AI driven components with deterministic logic to support complex transformation and automation use cases across multiple business units. Operating in a regulated financial services environment, the role requires a strong engineering mindset with compliance, governance, and responsible use of AI treated as core design principles.

What You Do

Design and maintain RESTful APIs with robust versioning strategies, ensuring stability as model behaviour evolves across releases.
Define structured, validated response schemas that deliver deterministic, auditable outputs suitable for enterprise consumption.
Implement streaming response patterns (SSE / chunked HTTP) to enable real-time model output delivery to frontends and downstream systems.
Implement authentication and authorisation frameworks (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC, scopes) including service principal patterns for cloud-to-cloud integration across Azure, AWS, and Databricks.
Enforce data controls at the API layer — including input sanitisation, output filtering, and guardrails — ensuring responses meet compliance standards before leaving the system.
Build audit logging into the API contract so that every request and response is fully traceable for regulatory purposes.
Design background job patterns that return immediately to callers while model inference executes asynchronously.
Integrate with message queues and event-driven architectures (Azure Service Bus, SQS, Kafka) for pipeline orchestration.

jobs.title: Senior Support Analyst (API & Cloud)
jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

OneTrust is looking for a Senior Support Analyst to join the CORE Platform Support team in Madrid. In this role, you will own complex technical support cases involving integrations, authentication, APIs, messaging, and platform-level functionality.

You will act as a trusted technical partner to customers and an escalation point for Support Analysts. You will investigate difficult issues, communicate clearly with customers, collaborate with Product and Engineering, and help strengthen the team’s technical capability through knowledge sharing and mentoring.

The CORE team supports customers across areas including Single Sign-On, SMTP, APIs, Data Discovery, Certification Automation integrations, tenant-wide performance issues, integration workflows, and integration requests.

Your Mission

Own and resolve complex CORE support cases escalated from Support Analysts, taking responsibility from initial investigation through resolution or an effective engineering handoff.
Troubleshoot advanced issues across SSO, SAML, SMTP, APIs, integrations, workflows, Data Discovery, and related platform capabilities.
Reproduce customer issues in appropriate test or support environments and use available evidence to identify probable causes and practical resolutions.
Analyse logs, trace information, configuration details, API requests, integration behaviour, and other technical evidence to isolate issues.
Provide clear, structured customer communication, including acknowledgement, investigation updates, action plans, and resolution explanations.
Determine when an issue requires escalation to Product or Engineering and raise high-quality Jira tickets with the relevant troubleshooting, evidence, impact, and technical questions.
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Incident Management, and other Support teams to drive complex issues to resolution.
Identify recurring issues, documentation gaps, workflow improvements, and opportunities to reduce repeat contacts and escalations.
Mentor and support other analysts through case reviews, technical guidance, troubleshooting walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Contribute to onboarding and enablement for new analysts joining the CORE team.
Maintain strong case ownership, accurate documentation, timely updates, and adherence to support processes and service-level expectations.
Continue building expertise through product releases, technical training, office hours, hands-on investigation, and relevant certifications.

You Are

Experience in a technical customer support, technical account support, SaaS support, application support, or similar role.
Demonstrated experience handling complex technical issues and escalations in a customer-facing environment.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work methodically from symptoms and evidence to a clear diagnosis.
Experience supporting integrations involving identity providers, APIs, data connectors, or workflow automation.
Practical understanding of several of the following areas:
SSO, SAML, identity providers, certificates, and authentication flows
SMTP, email delivery, connection testing, and email-related troubleshooting
Kubernetes
REST APIs, authentication, request/response analysis, and tools such as Postman
SaaS integrations, workflows, web technologies, and system dependencies

Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Experience working with ticketing and engineering collaboration tools, such as Salesforce and Jira.

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview .
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

jobs.description:
Join us as a Sr. Software Engineer on the R&D Software Team and own real software from the ground up — not a ticket queue. You'll shape the roadmap, make the technical calls, and build the real-time data platform that turns industrial IoT telemetry into decisions our customers can act on.

Where You'll Work: This is a remote-friendly role — most of your work in practice can be done remotely, with occasional in-person collaboration at our Porto office. Our engineers tell us that flexibility is one of the things they value most about working here.

Job Duties and Responsibilities: Reporting to the Digital Integration Director, you will own software solutions end to end, from framing the business problem to running services reliably in production, built on real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors monitoring liquid and gas storage tanks across industries including industrial chemical, industrial gas, propane, and other fuels. Collaborate for success

Own projects end to end, starting from a greenfield state: define your own requirements, shape the roadmap, and take solutions through to production.
Work cross-functionally with teams like Sales and Marketing, translating business goals into working software.
Make the technical decisions and contribute significantly to the implementation — this is a hands-on role, not a hand-off-to-others one.

Build data-driven systems

Build and operate the backend services and APIs behind a platform ingesting real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors at sites across the globe.
Design and run the data pipelines that turn that telemetry into something people can act on — including forecasting and anomaly detection on time series.
Work with the realities of sensor data: gaps, drift, irregular sampling, and a device population that keeps evolving. Bring the statistical judgment to tell a real signal from noise, and to say how confident we should be.
Run what you build — instrumentation, alerting, and the operational habits that keep a system healthy.

Engineer with AI assistance

Use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, and similar — as a normal part of daily delivery.
Hold AI-generated code to the same bar as any other code. You are accountable for what you ship.
Structure repositories, tests, and documentation so both people and agents can work in them effectively, and share the patterns and guardrails that work so the team's baseline rises.
Apply Anova's AI Handbook guidance on risk and human-in-the-loop validation to any system whose output reaches a customer or drives an automated action.

Advocate for quality

Contribute to and continuously adapt best practices and Ways of Working across software engineering, data engineering, and platform operations, so the team ships high-quality solutions that create real impact for our clients.

What Success Looks Like

Backend services and data pipelines for real-time IoT telemetry run reliably in production, with strong instrumentation and alerting in place.
Forecasting and anomaly detection outputs are trustworthy enough that customers and internal stakeholders act on them with confidence.
Engineering practices — code review, testing, CI/CD, AI-assisted development — visibly raise the team's baseline, not just this person's own output.
Other engineers are actively mentored and leveled up through code review and design discussion.
Business stakeholders trust this person to translate technical trade-offs and uncertainty into decisions they can act on.

What you'll need to succeed: Minimum Requirements -

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or another quantitative or scientific field — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
5+ years in software engineering or a closely related role, including hands-on production deployment (6–8 years preferred). A completed PhD in a quantitative or scientific discipline, with substantial hands-on programming, counts toward this.
Strong Python and the engineering habits that go with it: git, code review, linters, unit tests, and CI/CD pipelines are things you use daily.
Strong analytical ability and working fluency with statistics: distributions, uncertainty, correlation and causation, and knowing when a result is real.
Solid SQL and experience working with data at scale — pandas, PySpark, and platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Postgres.
Experience operating software in production: deployment, monitoring, alerting, and a feel for the practices that make that sustainable.
Fluency with agentic coding tools.
Fluent in written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications -

Depth in the Azure Databricks platform: PySpark, streaming pipelines.
Time series work in production: forecasting, anomaly detection, or similar.
Experience with message queuing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
Experience implementing agentic workflows in production — building them, not just calling them.
Hands-on with an agent framework: LangChain / LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MetaGPT, or similar. We care that you have shipped one, not which one.
Familiarity with the interoperability protocols — MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent2Agent) — for exposing systems as tools other agents can call directly, and for getting agents to talk to each other.
Experience with Microsoft Foundry for building, evaluating, and deploying agents.
Domain experience in industrial, energy, or IoT settings.

About Anova

We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents (m/f/x)
new_jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About This Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role

Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.
Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.
Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.
Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.
Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.
Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.
Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.
The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What You Will Need

5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.
Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.
Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.
Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it.
Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.
A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.
Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.
Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.
Fluency in English is a must.

What We Offer

Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.
Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.
A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.
Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.
Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.
We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

new_jobs.title: Software Engineers
new_jobs.description:
MSAB is a global leader in digital forensic technology for mobile device examination and analysis. The MSAB vision is to empower every investigation with digital forensic solutions – for a safer world. A core value is to run an ethics-driven company with innovation and results. The sole focus of MSAB is on delivering high quality digital forensic solutions to collect, review, analyze and manage data. MSAB is a trusted partner to Law Enforcement, Defence Forces, Government Agencies and Forensic Laboratories in democratic countries throughout the world enabling them to investigate crime, gather intelligence, investigate fraud and fight corruption.

To our new Stockholm office we’re looking for two engineers to join our Unicore team. You enjoy building systems that are not only functional, but also efficient, scalable, and thoughtfully designed. This is a chance to work with technology with a purpose – to create a safer world.

The job

At MSAB, the Unicore team is responsible for the core of our digital forensics platform, including UNIFY and the XRY file format (Core API). We’re now working on the next generation of UNIFY, and this is an opportunity to help shape it from the inside.

In this role, you will work with core system development where performance and reliability are critical. You’ll be dealing with distributed systems and data-intensive workloads, contributing to architectural decisions with long-term impact, and exploring how to best leverage hardware such as CPU and GPU.

Our current tech stack includes C99, C++20, and C# (.NET 8/10), along with gRPC, SQLite and PostgreSQL, running across both Windows and Linux environments.

Who You Are

We believe you will thrive in this environment if you have a genuine interest in programming and problem-solving, and if you care about performance, clean design, and user experience. You likely enjoy systems engineering, think in terms of trade-offs, and prefer solving meaningful problems over fitting into rigid roles. An appreciation for simplicity and keeping dependencies lean will serve you well.

Your Experience

You will benefit from your experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices, containerization with Docker, or cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure which is considered a plus.
You will be part of a focused team working close to the core of the product, where your decisions matter and your code has real impact.

Interested, or know someone who might be? Reach out or apply — we’d love to connect.

There is much more to talk about, like values, our growth plans, technology choices etc., but we save that for the interview.

Welcome to apply now!

For more information about MSAB, please visit: http://www.msab.com

What we can offer

Create a safer world with us!
As one of the world’s leading digital forensics companies, MSAB leads the way in pioneering advancements that contribute to making our world safer.
Your work at MSAB will bridge the gap between technology and justice. You will be inspired to go beyond your comfort zone, and you will deal with challenging and meaningful projects. When you join us, you become part of a global team that aspires to create a safer digital future, one breakthrough at a time.
We can offer you an exciting work environment, where we value being innovative, acting ethically and delivering results in everything we do while our customers' needs are at the center. We are proud to be a fast-growing international company with more than 20+ nationalities and we work with things that really make a difference.
Every day at MSAB is an opportunity to redefine the future of digital forensics.
Are you up for the challenge?
